question_summary: Reinforcement for the slab-on-deck pour strip is shown differently in Structural General Notes S-001 versus Foundation Plan S-101 (additional #5 ties); after an initial directive to follow S-101, the field is asking whether that directive applies to all slab-on-deck pour strips on this level or only the one originally called out, and confirmation is needed before the next concrete pour.
routing_rationale: The unresolved conflict and follow-up scope question both concern structural reinforcement detailing, requiring the Structural Engineer to confirm applicability across all pour strips before concrete placement.
